$description: Truthy design tokens, Boarding Pass language. DTCG Format Module 2025.10. Every value is read from the approved screens in design/flow/screens (day: game-classic, browse-c, mode-select, game-streak, game-lives, game-timed, result-classic, result-timed, start, game-timed-up, game-streak-record, game-lives-out, result-streak, result-lives; night: game-classic-night, result-classic-night, start-night); the reference is game-classic.html. No token here is proposed: a value that no screen shows is not in this file. Read with design/system/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.

sky-100.$description: Day sky band 2; also the day page background.

cream-50.$description: Ticket paper (day) and light text on fills (day).

mist-50.$description: Sunk paper (day): answer slip, missed-card slip, unavailable card.

slate-300.$description: Day rule: dividers, perforation, blank dashes.

amber-500.$description: Day accent: carrier band, plane, progress dot, logo mark.

midnight-900.$description: Night sky band 2; also the night page background.

slate-700.$description: Night cloud fill, drawn at opacity 0.7.

midnight-925.$description: Night dark text on light fills (on-dark).

midnight-875.$description: Night ink on the amber accent (on-accent).

navy-900-a32.$description: Day scrim: navy-900 at 32%. Source: browse-c.html .scrim.

mist-50-a0.$description: Transparent end of the day list fade. Source: result-classic.html .fade.

slate-850-a0.$description: Transparent end of the night list fade. Source: result-classic-night.html .fade.

navy-900-a05.$description: Day press tint: navy-900 at 5%. Source: start.html .hit:active, .lv:active, .leg:active, .cont:active.

bone-100-a06.$description: Night press tint: bone-100 at 6%. Source: start-night.html --press.

black-a60.$description: Night scrim: black at 60%. Decided at implementation: the navy day scrim does not show on the night sky.

sky-1.$description: Sky band 0 to 22% of the screen height.

surface.$description: Page background behind the sky (alias of sky-2).

surface-raised.$description: Ticket paper, round buttons, destination cards, the fill-in pass, the continue-line icon disc, the Timed stub stamp fill, the sheet (day).

surface-sunk.$description: Answer slip, missed-cards slip, selected option row, pressed list row, unavailable card, sheet close button.

ink.$description: Primary text, icons, primary pill fill, focus ring.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, field labels, unchecked radio ring.

rule.$description: Dividers 1.5px, perforations, blank-field dashes, grab bar. Decorative: never the only carrier of meaning.

accent.$description: Carrier band, plane marker, progress dot, logo mark, focus ring around filled pills.

on-accent.$description: Text and glyphs on the amber band and plane. Day value equals ink; added by the night screens.

true.$description: True button fill, True swipe hint and intent stamp, links (source, Why).

false.$description: False button fill, False swipe hint and intent stamp.

correct.$description: Correct stamp, correct waypoint, New best stamp (slip and result).

wrong.$description: Not quite stamp, wrong waypoint square. Same value as false in both themes.

on-dark.$description: Label on True, False and ink pills. Light in day, dark in night.

cloud.$description: Cloud shapes on the sky, drawn at opacity.cloud.

scrim.$description: Dims the screen under the bottom sheet (the Leave round dialog).

surface-sunk-clear.$description: Transparent start of the 28px fade at the bottom of the missed-cards list.

focus-on-fill.$description: Focus ring on True, False and ink pills. Day contrast against the sky is only 1.6:1 (see DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, Accessibility).

press.$description: Pressed tint on the fill-in pass fields (ways back) and on the continue line. Hard-coded in start.html; --press in start-night.html.

sky-1.$description: Sky band 0 to 22% of the screen height.

surface.$description: Page background behind the sky (alias of sky-2).

surface-raised.$description: Ticket paper, round buttons, destination cards, the fill-in pass, the continue-line icon disc, the Timed stub stamp fill, the sheet (day).

surface-sunk.$description: Answer slip, missed-cards slip, selected option row, pressed list row, unavailable card, sheet close button.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, field labels, unchecked radio ring.

rule.$description: Dividers 1.5px, perforations, blank-field dashes, grab bar. Decorative: never the only carrier of meaning.

false.$description: False button fill, False swipe hint and intent stamp.

correct.$description: Correct stamp, correct waypoint, New best stamp (slip and result).

wrong.$description: Not quite stamp, wrong waypoint square. Same value as false in both themes.

on-dark.$description: Label on True, False and ink pills. Light in day, dark in night.

cloud.$description: Cloud shapes on the sky, drawn at opacity.cloud.

focus-on-fill.$description: Focus ring on True, False and ink pills. Day contrast against the sky is only 1.6:1 (see DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, Accessibility).

press.$description: Pressed tint on the fill-in pass fields and the continue line. Source: start-night.html --press.

scrim.$description: Dims the screen under the Leave round sheet at night.

sans.$description: All text that is not a code or small data. Bundle SemiBold 600 and ExtraBold 800 only.

mono.$description: Codes, field labels, small data, links. Bundle Regular 400 and SemiBold 600 only.

sans-semibold.$description: Overpass SemiBold. Also what web renders for sans text with no weight set (400 is not loaded).

logo.$description: Truthy wordmark next to the logo mark, step 1 only.

screen-title.$description: Header title beside a round button.

step-title.$description: The one question of a start-flow step, in a 36px row.

tagline.$description: One description line under the logo; colour ink-muted.

card-statement.$description: The true/false statement on the ticket.

card-name.$description: Name on an area or platform destination card.

answer-value.$description: The correct answer word (True / False) on the answer slip.

answer-label.$description: "The answer is" above answer-value; colour ink-muted.

stamp.$description: Verdict stamp, 24px on the answer slip (Correct, Not quite, and New best in game-streak-record.html). Stub stamp variant 28px with padding 8 18 6 on a surface-raised fill: the Timed verdict (game-timed.html .tstamp) and Time is up in ink with a clock icon (game-timed-up.html .ustamp). Result-screen New best is 22px (result-timed.html, result-streak.html).

button.$description: Label of the 60px pills (False, True, Next card, Start round, Play again).

button-back.$description: Label of the 48px Back pill in the start flow.

carrier-title.$description: "Truthy" on the 44px carrier band. Compact pass while it is being filled: 14px (browse-c.html, start.html .p-car).

carrier-label.$description: Uppercase label on the carrier band (BOARDING PASS). Compact pass: 11px "YOUR PASS" (browse-c.html, start.html). The only uppercase text in the app.

leg-code.$description: Three-letter deck or section code on the ticket legs and the sheet head.

leg-name.$description: Two-line name under a leg code; colour ink-muted.

field-label.$description: Small mono label above a field value (Class, Card, Area, Section, Cards). Colour ink-muted; ink at 600 for the field being chosen now (browse-c.html .now dt).

field-value.$description: Value in the ticket field grid. The fill-in pass uses field-value-pass instead.

field-value-pass.$description: Value in the fill-in pass (Cloud, AWS). The deck code there is mono 600 16px, letter-spacing .02em (browse-c.html .val.code).

body.$description: Explanation text. CSS sets no weight (400) but only 600 is loaded, so SemiBold renders; natives must ask for 600. Missed-card explanation is 15px (result-classic.html .mc-exp > p).

body-small.$description: One-line description under an option name; colour ink-muted.

list-title.$description: Row title in lists. 800 for the Whole deck row. Deck name on a deck card is 16/1.25 (browse-c.html .dname).

option-title.$description: Class name in an option row.

emphasis.$description: Short emphasised line such as "2 short of your best". Missed-card answer word is 17px (result-classic.html .ans b).

deck-code.$description: Code on a deck destination card.

section-code.$description: Code at the start of a section row in the sheet.

score.$description: Result score number. Its unit ("of 10") is mono 600 20px, ink-muted, letter-spacing 0.

intent-stamp.$description: Drag preview stamp (True / False) that fades in while swiping.

mono-data.$description: Small data: stub row, card counts, comparison sub-line, subtitle, list header. Destination card sub-line is 12.5px (browse-c.html .sub).

mono-data-strong.$description: Emphasised small data and inline actions: swipe hint, Why link, stub card number, "3 to review", best values (line-height 1.3 in mode-select.html .best b). Source link is 13.5px (game-classic.html .source).

mono-caption.$description: Missed-card head (Card 03 / You said True); colour ink-muted.

route-label.$description: Label row under the flight path; numbers in it are 600. Timed clock is 600 13px with tabular figures (game-timed.html #clock).

sheet-title.$description: Sheet title ("New boarding pass"), colour ink.

pass-line.$description: Area and platform folded into one quiet line on the fill-in pass from the section step on ("Cloud · AWS"); colour ink-muted, separator dot in rule. Each word sits in a 22px tall tap row whose hit area is extended to 48.

2.$description: Field value under its label, route label offset, deck card text gap.

4.$description: Destination card text gap, gap between result actions, subtitle offset.

6.$description: Leg name under its code, missed-card statement offset, small icon gaps.

8.$description: Icon-to-label gap, legs column gap, field cell top padding.

10.$description: Carrier band gap, pill icon gap, explanation offset, deck status offset.

12.$description: Default gap: header items, stage and actions offset, True/False gap, card list gap, field divider inset, option row padding.

14.$description: Legs top padding, compact carrier padding, logo-to-tagline gap.

16.$description: Screen gutter, carrier band padding, sheet bar padding.

18.$description: Statement top padding, answer slip top padding, destination card vertical padding.

20.$description: Inner ticket gutter: legs, field grid, statement, slip, lists, sheet.

24.$description: Statement bottom padding, step list bottom padding.

safe-top.$description: #app top padding; the contract keeps the top 50px free of interactive content.

safe-bottom.$description: #app bottom padding; the contract keeps the bottom 30px free.

max-width.$description: #app max-width; the design viewport is 390 x 844.

touch-min.$description: Minimum touch target in every screen.

header.$description: Header row (.top) in game, result and mode screens.

start-top-zone.$description: Top zone of the start flow: logo and tagline on step 1; Back pill + fill-in pass on steps 2 to 6; on step 7 the pass becomes the first card and the header becomes the flight path.

pill.$description: Primary, True and False pill height.

pill-small.$description: Quiet button and Back pill height.

actions.$description: Actions row height under the ticket.

carrier.$description: Carrier band height on the full ticket.

carrier-compact.$description: Carrier band height on the fill-in pass while it is being filled (steps 2 to 5). From step 6 the band grows to size.carrier (44).

lower.$description: Stub / answer slip height in game screens.

notch.$description: Radius of the side notches at the perforation.

card-notch.$description: Radius of the top and bottom notches on a destination card stub line.

card-stub.$description: Stub width of an area or platform card.

card-stub-deck.$description: Stub width of a deck card.

card-min.$description: Area or platform card minimum height.

list-row.$description: Section row minimum height in the sheet.

sheet-overrun.$description: How far the sheet extends below the screen edge so spring overshoot never shows a gap.

radio.$description: Radio mark diameter in option rows.

flight-path-height.$description: Flight path drawing height (viewBox 276 x 34, scaled to the available width).

card-min-section.$description: Section card (start step 4): stub 80, padding 14 top and bottom. Source: start.html .c.sec.

card-min-class.$description: Class card (start step 5): stub 80, padding 16 top and bottom. Source: start.html .c.cls.

pass-line.$description: Height of the quiet area/platform line on the route pass (padding 8 10 0; each word a 22 tall row). Source: start.html .p-line.

continue-icon.$description: Disc behind the logo mark (26 x 18) on the continue line. The whole line is 60 tall, like a pill. Source: start.html .cont .ci.

foot-gap.$description: Space the start-flow card list leaves at the bottom of step 1 when the continue line is shown (60 line + 16). Source: start.html .main margin-bottom.

ready-offset.$description: Top padding of the "Your pass is ready" step, so its title clears the full-size pass. Source: start.html .step[data-for="6"].

card.$description: --r: ticket, destination card, fill-in pass, sheet top corners.

small.$description: --r-sm: stamps, option rows, Why focus, list row focus.

pill-small.$description: Half of the 48px quiet button and Back pill.

tick.$description: Blank dashes, grab bar, wrong-waypoint square (rx 2).

rule.$description: Dividers, field grid lines, list separators, option row border, vertical card perforation.

perforation.$description: Horizontal perforation height; dashes 7px on, 5px off.

focus.$description: Focus outline width; offset 3px (0 on Why, -1px on sheet rows, 2px on option rows).

stamp.$description: Stamp border: CSS 3px double, i.e. two 1px lines with a 1px gap. Intent stamp is 3px solid.

quote.$description: Left rule beside an opened missed-card explanation.

icon.$description: Close and leave X icon stroke. Other icon strokes are listed in DESIGN-SYSTEM.md.

disabled.$description: True and False pills during the Timed stamp beat (game-timed.html).

ticket.$description: --shadow: the boarding pass (drawn on a separate shadow box under the notched paper). Source: game-classic.html.

small.$description: Round button, Back pill, destination card, fill-in pass. Hard-coded in game-classic.html .close and browse-c.html .soft.

press.$description: Pill while pressed. Hard-coded in game-classic.html .btn:active.

sheet.$description: Bottom sheet, the ticket recipe pointing up. Source: browse-c.html .sheet.
Bottom sheet at night: the night ticket recipe pointing up. Decided at implementation for the Leave round dialog.

t1.$description: Fast: press feedback, radio fill, list row highlight.

t2.$description: Base: answer-row swap, Why chevron, plane fade, option row selection.

t3.$description: Slow: card snap-back, stub pull, scrim, sheet close, Why expand, start-flow step.

jolt.$description: Ticket jolts 2px when the stamp lands.

stamp-timed.$description: Stamp on the stub: Timed verdict (no delay) and Time is up (delay 120).

deal-timed.$description: Timed next card is dealt in.

hold-timed.$description: Timed: from tap until the card leaves (the builder suggested 700; open question).

travel-hold.$description: Start flow: pause before the chosen name travels.

travel.$description: Start flow: the chosen name travels into or out of its field.

step-enter.$description: Start flow: incoming title and cards; also the incoming top zone.

step-enter-delay.$description: Start flow: first incoming item delay.

step-stagger.$description: Start flow: extra delay per incoming item.

top-exit.$description: Start flow: outgoing top zone (logo or pass).

top-enter-delay.$description: Start flow: incoming top zone delay.

reduced-out.$description: Reduced motion: old step fades out.

reduced-in.$description: Reduced motion: new step fades in (delay 90).

board.$description: Start flow: the full pass grows into the first card of the round (step 6 to 7) or rolls back up. Same length as the stub tear.

strike.$description: Three lives: the slash is drawn through the last heart as the stamp lands (delay 380, ease). Source: game-lives-out.html.

spring.$description: --spring on web. Overshoots ~10%. Natives use motion.spring.* instead.

fall.$description: Accelerating curve for the stub tear and the Timed card leaving.

ease-in.$description: CSS ease-in keyword: opacity of the tearing stub and the leaving Timed card.

ease-out.$description: CSS ease-out keyword: start-flow outgoing items.

snap.$description: Card snap-back after a short drag, stub pull settle. Also used at t2 for the radio check pop (mode-select.html).

ch.truthy.note: Fitted so the native spring peaks at the same moment (57% of 360 ms) with the same ~10% overshoot as the web curve. Feed the release velocity on native for drag-driven springs.

land.$description: Stamp landing (delay 380 in game screens) and the sheet rising.

ch.truthy.note: Fitted so the native spring peaks at the same moment (57% of 420 ms) with the same ~10% overshoot as the web curve. Feed the release velocity on native for drag-driven springs.
Fitted so the native spring peaks at the same moment (57% of 300 ms) with the same ~10% overshoot as the web curve. Feed the release velocity on native for drag-driven springs.

press.$description: Press scale or offset on every control.

answer-row.$description: Next card pill rises 12px and fades in after the tear.

tear.$description: Stub tears: translate(-40px, 360px) rotate(-18deg) for correct, (40px, 360px) 18deg for wrong; opacity to 0 with ease-in.

stamp.$description: Stamp: from scale 1.9, rotate -14deg, opacity 0 to scale 1, rotate -6deg, opacity 1.

jolt.$description: Ticket main part: translateY 2px at 40% and back. Delay 120 in Timed, 240 on Time is up.

sheet-close.$description: Sheet back to translateY(104%); scrim fades with the same timing both ways.

disclosure.$description: Why explanation height 0 to auto; chevron rotates 180deg over t2.

travel.$description: Chosen name moves and scales into its pass field (translate + scale only).

step-enter.$description: Incoming items from translateY(24px) (forward) or -24px (back), plus 25ms per item.

step-exit.$description: Outgoing items to translateY(-10px) (forward) or 10px (back). Title uses 80ms.

timed-leave.$description: Timed card leaves: translateX(+/-120%) rotate(+/-8deg) toward the answer side, opacity ease-in.

timed-deal.$description: Timed next card from translateY(14px), opacity 0.

pass-resize.$description: Fill-in pass changes size between layouts (height and y together, band height and type with it); old block fades out 120 ease-out, new block fades in 220 after 90. Source: start.html go().

pass-board.$description: Start round: the pass grows into the first card; statement fades up from 8px (260, delay 220), stub print fades in (240, delay 260), Back fades out and the flight-path header comes in (240, delay 160). Reverse on Leave round.

commit-distance.$description: Horizontal drag beyond which the swipe answers (right True, left False).

intent-distance.$description: Drag distance at which intent reaches 1 (intent = clamp(dx / 110, -1, 1)).

stub-pull.$description: Stub drops |intent| x 7px and rotates intent x 2deg about 20% 0 while dragging.
